title: Focus Hack #2: a phone deal you'll keep
cta: Executive Functioning Workbook for Teens · link in bio

copy.caption: Want fewer phone fights? Offer a deal first: pick your homework window, keep the phone away until it's done, and review it on Sunday. A deal you helped write is easier to keep. Executive Functioning Workbook for Teens (30 short sessions, 6 skills): link in bio.
copy.yt_title: Make a Phone Deal Your Parents Will Say Yes To
copy.pin_title: How Teens Can Make a Screen-Time Deal That Sticks
copy.pin_desc: Pick your homework window, keep the phone away until it's done, review it on Sunday. From the Julia Redmond executive function series for teens.
